outages.description: An incident on the high-voltage grid disrupted power in Abidjan and other areas, causing a significant drop in Internet traffic across Côte d'Ivoire.
A fault on 90 kV transmission lines cut power to French Guiana's coastal grid, causing a significant drop in Internet traffic across providers.
A fixed-line network disruption caused a significant drop in Internet traffic from Salt (AS15796) in Switzerland
A fault on the SEA-ME-WE 5 submarine cable off Pakistan's coast caused a drop in Internet traffic across Pakistan
